1. Added localization

- Removed unused cards from the card collection.

notes.content:
Ver 0.90.01

[b]Updates[/b]

1. Final Chapter changed from 7 Chapter to 5 Chapter
    - Chapter Monster ha been relocated.
    - Monsters have changed HP and Skills.
    - Chapter 1~5 the map's path has been changed.
    - Add new battle background image and battle background effect.
2. New 11 kinds of Monster
    - 1 kinds of boss monster
        - Devourer
    
    - 3 kinds of elite monster
        - Captain Joe
        - Transformer Golem
        - Dr. Virus
        
    - 7 kinds of normal monster
        - Goat Warlock
        - Gargoyle
        - Yeti
        - Marley the Penguin
        - Mad Snowman
        - Gem Fox
        - Jewel Sheep
        
3. New 21 kinds of artifact
    - 15 kinds of hero artifact
        - Joanna's Lost Shield
        - Kyle's Lost Commendation
        - Olga's lost voodoo doll
        - Adora's Lost Necklace
        - Deia's Lost Ring
        - Rouge's Lost Dagger
        - Kliff's Lost Apparel
        - Kasa's Lost Pouch
        - Leona's Lost Bow
        - Belfamie's Lost Wolf Necklace
        - Ralcah's Lost Anklet
        - Chiron's Lost Spellbook
        - Liu's Lost Beanie
        - Kigal's Lost Leaves
        - Henry's Lost Tool Box
    - 6 kinds of her attribute artifact
        - Flag of Attack
        - Anger drug
        - Flag of Defense
        - Patience medicine
        - Flag of Support
        - Recovery medicine
        
4. New 10 kinds of card
    - 6 kinds of attack card
        - Predator, Predator+
        - An unknown fire, An unknown fire+
        - Acid cloud, Acid cloud+
        
    - 4 kinds of aid card
        - A brutal commander, A brutal commander+
        - Muscle strengthening, Muscle strengthening+
5. Added Inn System
    - The party will be recovery HP when you relax at the inn.
    - The rest of the inn has a shorty break and a long break.
    - The inn can only be used once.
6. Changed mastery points gain method.
    - The way to gain when moving the map has been changed to a from in which the chapter boss is cleared.
    - When clearing the chapter boss by the shortest distance, gain the most mastery points.
    - Mastery points are only usable in shop.
    - Mastery points can be used when clearing the final chapter.
    
7. The starting artifact slot has been increased from 1 to 3.
8. Change card balance
    - Attack card
        - Deadly Game : added damage 40.
        - Deadly Game + : added damage 50.
        - Shield Throw, Shield Throw + : changed to Destroyed.
        - Mutual Destruction : changed unit current HP damage rate from 100% to 300%.
        - Mutual Destruction + : changed unit current HP damage rate from 100% to 500%.
        - Assault + : changed damage value from 28 to 32.
        - Block and Strike + : changed damage value from 29 to 33.
        
    - Aid card
        - Voluntary Sacrifice : added restores 30 HP to all allies.
        - Voluntary Sacrifice + : added restores 30 HP to all allies.
        - Ultimate Sacrifice : added restores 20 HP to all allies.
        - Ultimate Sacrifice + : added restores 30 HP to all allies.
        - Greater Heal + : removed card discard.
        - Continuous Heal + : changed restore value from 15 to 26.
        
    - Power card
        - Book of Wisdom : card cost has been changed from 1 to 2.
        - Book of Wisdom + : card cost has been changed from 0 to 1.
        
9. The English translation has been changed better than before.
Bug fixes
    - Fixed an issue where random event 'Crystal Cave' to gain hero unit. now gain random monster unit.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Damage to All', 'Damage to All +' card used to the card did not change to the card text 'All'.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Immortality', 'Immortality +' card used after, the unit died when using 'kill instance' skill.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Poisoned Blade', 'Poisoned Blade +' card used after, enemy all attack that one unit instead of all attacked units gain toxic.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Doppelganger', 'Doppelganger +' card text had been modified to include missing text 'destroyed card expect'
    - Fixed an issue where 'Medical Care', 'Medical Care +', 'Close Connection', 'Close Connection +' card is used skill did not work.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Ultimate Sacrifice' ,'Ultimate Sacrifice +' card is used the unit died and the hero HP did not recover.
    - Fixed an issue where 'Voluntary Sacrifice', 'Voluntary Sacrifice +' card is used the unit died and the hero defence did not added.

※ Our development team decided that it would be better to reduce the final chapter to chapter 5 rather than proceeding to chapter 7 and to make the configuration more aware by users' various suggestions and feedback.
In addition, the mastery point gain method has been modified to take into account the balance between acquiring monsters and other goods, and clearing the chapter with the shortest distance.
I look forward to your feedback. Thank you.

notes.title: Upcoming patches..
notes.content:
First of all, we'd like to thank you for all those who have joined our Early access and give us wonderful feedback. Our team really excited that there are so many players have joined us!!

It's been 3 days from we've started an Early access, we've gathered a lot of feedback from community - and from the logs.

There are lots to develop, but we're going to focus following issues first :

[h1][b]Localization[/b][/h1]
We've noticed that there are so many problems in localization. Since we're from Asia, English is not our mother tongue. So we've passed the text to the localization company to translate, but it seems not that good enough due to lack of knowledge of our game.

So we've decided to translate the text by ourselves. We don't speak English very well, though we can make it more comprehend.

We hope we can update the first localization in a week.

[h1][b]Tutorial[/b][/h1]
A lot of players have complained that we have no Tutorial. So we're going to add a simple Tutorial for the new players. It may not look so good, but can be helpful for the new player.

We will add the Tutorial menu at the main menu, and will not bother players who doesn't need it.

[h1][b]Balances[/b][/h1]
We're keep changing balances and will change a lot more. It'd be great if you can give us any kind of feedback. We will constantly check the community hub and the game play logs to change a balance.

Don't hesitate to tell us about anything. We will deeply consider your opinion.

[h1][b]New mode!![/b][/h1]
It's cautious to announce at this early stage, but we're considering to develop a new mode. The main idea comes from the review of '[b]Hvaki Spark[/b]' in Russian. He mentioned about very exciting idea and our team think we'd like to develop a new mode. Thank you for the head up, Hvaki!! 

We're not sure about the timeline yet, but we will update you as soon as we figured a specific plan. It'd be great to give us an inspiration for the next update, so if you have any ideas, just let us know!

Hope you can enjoy our game, and we will come back with better updates!

Thank you!

We will add the Tutorial menu at the main menu, and will not bother players who doesn't need it.

tags.balance_change: We're keep changing balances and will change a lot more.

tags.feature: It's cautious to announce at this early stage, but we're considering to develop a new mode.

Destiny or Fate has been started an Early access today!

Hope you can enjoy it and don't hesitate send us any kind of feedback!

However, we've made a few updates today.

Please check the patch note #1.


[h1]Patch Note #1[/h1]

[b]Updates[/b]
 - Increased purchasing cost for mastery. sadly.
 - Support window mode.
 - Adjusted game balances.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
